problems.problem: The regenerated lacquer now renders visible panel joints that the prompt explicitly forbade: a hard horizontal edge line crosses the full canvas at y≈1045 (passing behind the bottle between label and base) and short vertical mitre seams run down both侧 edges from that line to the bottom corners, so the 'seamless coat' reads as a boxed lacquer plinth with tiled corners. The requested mirrored echo did arrive (soft vertical glow pool under the base, visible in crop 298,1063,782,1313), but it is bought at the cost of grooves that fight the concept's continuous-lacquer material story.

The cream patch rendered only partially: logo 'TOM FORD' (y=65-83) and subtitle 'EAU DE PARFUM' (y=223-241) are now #efe6d2 cream, but the 66px title 'TOBACCO VANILLE' (y=122-170) still prints dark brown #261E16. Inside one stacked band the voice color therefore flips cream-dark-cream, and the dark title sits exactly in the brightest core of the upper light pool, inverting the concept's cream-on-lacquer reading at the single largest type element.

Contact integration now matches the references: crop 298,1063,782,1313 shows a tight soft contact shadow hugging the base at y=1203 plus a mirrored glow echo beneath, answering the staged-material logic of refs 4-5. What still trails them is retouching richness on the hero itself: the brown glass carries only two small cap highlights and no teal lacquer bounce on its shoulders or sides, so against refs 3 and 5 (where the field color lives inside the glass) the bottle still reads slightly decal-like on the field.
